note: Banco Unión's tariffs: its Visa Internacional card costs 300 bolivianos a year to maintain, in four monthly instalments (service tariff of 21 October 2026), and bears a fixed 17% the first year and 20% after (interest rate tariff of 27 October 2026); the first year's lower rate is introductory, so 20% is written.

sources.said: Costo anual de mantenimiento (en 4 cuotas mensuales) Visa Internacional Bs. 300,00
